SELECT mr.team_result AS teamResult, mr.stadium_id AS stadiumId, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName FROM match_record mr JOIN stadium s ON s.id = mr.stadium_id
JOIN category c ON c.id = mr.category_id
WHERE mr.user_id = #{userId} AND mr.match_date >= #{startDate} AND mr.match_date < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND c.category_name = #{category}
